title: Deployment QA wait and connection recovery
summary: The driver executes server-selected pending plans outside bounded dispatch threads, preserving its acting session and candidate checkout. Target digests isolate live groups in one session. It polls QA facts, dispatches on change, and gives the final deadline dispatch a normal poll interval. Review and manual evidence stay waiting while other groups run. Recovery commands name the selected connection and run. Older serving replies without pending plans retain notice-based recovery. When the driver exits at the wait, control-plane upkeep sends each unsent, addressable item-QA member its stage-wait notice under the driver's own key, so no re-drive is needed to wake it; the fleet report shows that member as wake pending until it does.
